title: A Thousand Mountains | The Sunset, the Breeze, and You
subtitle: So intoxicated I forget the way home; only the wind, the moon, and joy with you.
body:
**NOTE:**

The sunset I chased for three days in Yellowstone and never saw

Came straight at me on my first day back in the Burg

Walking slowly along the railway, pushing my bicycle

Behind me, clouds ablaze with deep red light and flecks of gold

In truth, I did not go to look at the sunset

Nor to admire the breeze

I was only walking and thinking

If you were at the end of the railway

Then let me keep walking, on and on
